etl.script: CREATE TABLE CUSTOMER ( ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CUSTOMER_NAME VARCHAR(100), ACTIVE BOOLEAN, FIRST_PRICE DECIMAL(12, 2), EXTERNAL_CODE VARCHAR(20), NOTE VARCHAR(100) );
